# gui-checklist-execution

Use this skill to execute the shared GUI checklist against one selected screen.

Rules:

- load `gui_checklist.md`
- inspect one selected screen
- determine applicability
- record `Passed`, `Failed`, or `N/A`
- require evidence for every `Failed` result
- link related finding IDs
- never invent results
- separate direct observation from inference
- ask for human confirmation before treating uncertain observations as findings
